verdict: Keysight's revenue jumped 37% to a record $1.85B and net income doubled to $397M, as testing gear for AI data centers drove a second straight quarter of more than $2B in orders.

segments.name: Communications Solutions
segments.note: Test gear for networks and data centers — commercial communications grew 56% on AI infrastructure demand; aerospace, defense and government grew 14%.

segments.name: Electronic Industrial Solutions
segments.note: Test equipment for semiconductors, general electronics, automotive and energy — all grew.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the next generation of measurement instruments and software.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling and supporting measurement gear worldwide ($446M of SG&A, net of $3M of other operating income).

otherDetail: Net other income of $16M — $20M of interest income and $22M of other income, less $26M of interest expense.

takeaways.title: Orders are outrunning sales
takeaways.text: Orders of $2.09B exceeded revenue for a second straight quarter — a backlog signal that demand for AI data-center testing is still building.

takeaways.title: Q4 guided to another record
takeaways.text: Keysight guided fiscal Q4 revenue to $1.93–1.95B (about +37% YoY at the midpoint) and raised its full-year outlook.

takeaways.title: Cash followed profit
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $403M in the quarter, and the cash pile reached $2.62B.

footerNote: This is Keysight's latest reported quarter: fiscal Q4 2026 (ended October 31, 2026) had not yet been reported when this page was published.
